"""Docstrings carrying the route clause the rule rejects; each function is one hit."""


def direct():
    """A pure client of ``POST /api/things/{id}/go``."""


def single_backtick():
    """A thin client of `GET /api/things`."""


def bare_route():
    """A client of DELETE /api/things/{id}."""


def hub_api_form():
    """A pure client of the hub API: ``POST /api/things/{id}/promote``."""


def fractional_form():
    """Client of the fractional ``POST /api/queue/position``."""


def wrapped():
    """A pure client
    of ``PATCH /api/things/{id}``."""


def wrapped_before_route():
    """A pure client of ``PUT
    /api/things``."""
